state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`: stage 5 (Install and Guides) is in progress. Install and seven of the eight Guides sections are done. Example apps is the last one.**

Install has four pages under `install/`, snippets under `website/snippets/install/`. Novis has no release yet, so the install page builds from source, and the Docker page copies a binary the reader built.

Guides: Why people pick Novis (11 candidate pages; the user curates the list when the goal lands), the Tour (ten steps), Simple programs (six), How to use Novis (six pages, each with `## Do and don't`), Cookbook (ten), Testing your app (four) and Going to production (five). Each program has its own folder under `website/snippets/guides/<section>/<name>/`, with its `nvs.toml` and `.nvsr` beside it. `nvs test` output and compile errors are `txt` blocks copied from a real run.

Novis has no free functions (`E0215`, `E0320`), so every snippet uses a class and `Core\Math::intDiv` and so on. `Core\Request::query` returns `mixed`: write `as tainted string` or `as ?int`. A route is tested in one file with the `catch (LogicError)` pattern in `website/snippets/guides/testing/test-a-route/test-a-route.nvs`.

`--check guides` fails now only on `example-apps`. `site structure`, `stale`, `reference`, `syntax` and `--build` pass. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stage 6 rewrites. `apps` and `in-depth` are stubs (`LATER` in `site.ts`).

A page whose `covers:` names a feature id needs `bun nv site --stamp <page>` before `--check stale` passes.

items.text: **The Notes app**: `apps/notes/` with SQLite, server-rendered HTML with html literals, a small JSON API, form validation and tests, run with `nvs serve` and `nvs test`. Specified by `docs/agent/goals/side/website-overhaul.md` § Stage 5, item 8. Its database snippets follow `website/snippets/guides/cookbook/page-db-rows/` (`Core\Db::connect`, `[db.<name>]`, `[capabilities.db] connect`). Anchors: `website/astro.config.ts:209`

**`--check apps`**: replace the `apps` entry of `LATER` with a part that runs `nvs test` over every app under `apps/` and boots each with `nvs serve` until `/` returns `200`. Specified by the same section. Anchors: `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:66`

**The Example apps page**: `guides/example-apps/index.mdx` and `guides/example-apps/notes.mdx` (sparse `git clone` of `apps/notes`, `cd`, `nvs serve`, `nvs test`, what each file does, how to start a new app from it), and a Guides sidebar group after Going to production. Anchors: `website/astro.config.ts:209`, `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:563`

backlog: Stage 6: In-Depth's eight sections, the home page rewrite, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx` prose, and `--check in-depth` — `docs/agent/goals/side/website-overhaul.md` § Stage 6.
